mapper.select: SELECT gid, id, gridcode, geom, ST_X(ST_Centroid(geom)) as centerLon, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geom)) as centerLat FROM xian_dem WHERE ST_Contains(geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}, #{lat}), 4490))

SELECT gid, id, gridcode, geom, ST_X(ST_Centroid(geom)) as centerLon, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geom)) as centerLat FROM xian_dem WHERE gridcode = ( SELECT MIN(gridcode) FROM xian_dem WHERE ST_DWithin( ST_Centroid(geom), ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{centerLon}, #{centerLat}), 4490), #{distance} ) ) AND ST_DWithin( ST_Centroid(geom), ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{centerLon}, #{centerLat}), 4490), #{distance} ) LIMIT 1
